source.author: verg
source.text: Et iam finis erat, cum Iuppiter aethere summo despiciens mare velivolum terrasque iacentis litoraque et latos populos, sic vertice caeli constitit, et Libyae defixit lumina regnis.
source.text_original: Et iam finis erat, cum Iuppiter aethere summo / despiciens mare velivolum terrasque iacentis / litoraque et latos populos, sic vertice caeli / constitit, et Libyae defixit lumina regnis.
source.text_english: And now it was the end, when Jupiter, looking down from the highest heaven upon the sea with its sails, the lands lying below, and the shores and broad nations, thus stood on the summit of the sky, and fixed his eyes on the realms of Libya.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text_english: And now it was the end.
